audit_item: F7 / release Native metric spool after terminal failure
finding: Spool cleanup initially covered successful report finalization only. A failed snapshot update or failed report finalization permanently poisoned the Native accumulator but left its temporary return spool open.
change: Both terminal failure boundaries now release metric return storage immediately. The original validation error remains primary; a cleanup error, if any, is attached as an exception note. Existing failure state and event indexes remain available for diagnosis.

verification.ruff: passed for native_metrics.py, metrics.py, and test_native_report_accumulator_parity.py
failure_lifecycle_regressions: A non-chronological snapshot closes the disk-backed return spool.
A finalization failure with an insufficient account series closes the disk-backed return spool.

boundary: Synthetic failure-path lifecycle tests only. This does not establish full-history process RSS or alter the O(n) output-fact contract.
